rationale: The new model11 graph optimizer treated a numerical literal-grid proposal as permission to detach a valid dependent T junction from an already exact diagonal support. The native-editor invariant exposed this 1.84-line defect; protect current graph constraints and retain the addressed sequence regressions.

summary.ru: Optimize сохраняет законные зависимые T-узлы; последовательности редактора и удаления не оставляют работу по геометрии и layout.
summary.en: Optimize preserves valid dependent T junctions, with native editor and deletion sequences checked for geometry and layout maintenance debt.
